about: E31 adjoint_sgd. Plan reports/2026-10-22_plan_adjoint-sgd.md (design check there; the user asked for this experiment 2026-10-22). Filed before the run; never edited after.

setup.finetunes: arm A (CE at the trigger + KL elsewhere), batch 32, clip 1, all 24 matrices, 1000 steps, delta-W at (10, 100, 1000). Emoticon seed 0: Adam 3e-5, SGD 0.01, Adam 3e-6; emoticon seed 1: the same three; r1_t534_v369 and r0_t352_v310 seed 0: SGD at the rate E4's rule picks from (0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1) at step 10 (P >= 0.9, KL elsewhere <= {'r1_t534_v369': 0.24301687240600586, 'r0_t352_v310': 0.20851298211847694}), and Adam 3e-5
setup.states: per checkpoint: do-nothing and the scaled adjoint split (split.adjoint_state) through harness.measure: Pile ratios (256 rows, 20 PGD steps), held-out P(target) at the trigger (route split T1), Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2
setup.reproduced_share: R = 1 - sum_k ||(c_k K(dW_k) - dW_k) Sigma_k^1/2||^2 / sum_k ||dW_k Sigma_k^1/2||^2 over the non-zero matrices (split.reproduced_share), K(M) = U U^T M + M V V^T, c_k adjoint_split's scale; Sigma = W0's input second moments on the task's training windows (also the scale c's)
setup.keep_ratio: adjoint state's held-out P(target) / the fine-tune's own held-out P(target), same checkpoint
setup.budget: gamma.pgd_sources, n in (20, 40, 80, 160) sign steps of 2/n from the seed's random start, first 128 Pile val rows in batches of 8, fp32 KL (cancel.masked_kl); ratio = state KL (seed 0) / W0 KL (seed 0) at the same n
setup.verdict: faith_score.verdict on the adversarial (PGD) ratio to the same-job W0 under adversary seed 0: pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f), fail >= 1.5 (1 + f); f = max/min - 1 of W0's PGD KL over seeds 0, 1 (H100 about 0.075 -> 1.40 / 1.61)

gates.G0_w0: first, alone: faith_score.w0_check. Fails: stop, nothing scored
gates.G1_reproduce_E22: emoticon seed 0 Adam 3e-5, SGD 0.01, Adam 3e-6: adjoint P(target) within 0.05 of E22's {'adam 3e-05': (0.9333, 0.5997, 0.1038), 'sgd 0.01': (0.7144, 0.7535, 0.6132), 'adam 3e-06': (0.6936, 0.4667, 0.2378)} at every step. Fails: stop
gates.G2_R_reproduces_E14: emoticon seed 0 Adam 3e-5: R within 0.03 of E14's (0.5763, 0.4222, 0.3064). Fails: P3 unscored (positive control of the new measurement), the run goes on
gates.C_delta: every adjoint state's Delta share <= 0.001 (positive control that the measurement reads 0)
gates.C_budget_w0: W0 seed 0 at 20 budget steps within 5% of E20 A3's 0.6604 (L40). Fails: P4 reported, unscored

predictions.measure: emoticon seed 1, step 1000: SGD 0.01's adjoint state; Adam 3e-6's adjoint state
predictions.pass: SGD: P(target) >= 0.5, Delta share <= 0.001, verdict 'pass'; and Adam 3e-6's P(target) <= SGD's - 0.2
predictions.relative_vs_absolute: absolute P(target) and Delta share; ratio relative to W0
predictions.predicted: pass: E22 seed 0 read SGD 0.61 and Adam 3e-6 0.24 at step 1000, both passing with Delta 0
predictions.expected: W0: P(target) 0.004, ratio 1. Fine-tunes about 1.0. SGD adjoint 0.6-0.75, Adam 3e-6 adjoint about 0.25
predictions.blind_to: damage the 20-step adversary does not find; off-target damage of the adjoint state; P only at the trigger
predictions.noise_floor: P over the held-out windows (deterministic); one more training seed

predictions.measure: r1_t534_v369 and r0_t352_v310, step 1000: the SGD fine-tune's adjoint state vs Adam 3e-5's
predictions.pass: per task: SGD's adjoint P(target) >= 0.5 and >= Adam 3e-5's + 0.2, Delta share <= 0.001, verdict 'pass'. Reading: 'both' (pass), 'one task' (two-sided, reported which), 'neither' (fail). A task whose grid passes no rate is 'unscored' for that task
predictions.predicted: pass on both, medium-low confidence: the mechanism is optimiser-level, not task-level
predictions.expected: Adam 3e-5 adjoint about 0.1 at step 1000 (E14/E16 on emoticon); SGD rate 0.03 on r1 (E24)
predictions.blind_to: as P1; tasks from one family (single-token trigger and target)
predictions.positive_control: the Adam 3e-5 adjoint state's low P(target) on each task

predictions.measure: R of every fine-tune at every step; Spearman of keep_ratio on R over every adjoint state (n reported)
predictions.pass: (a) every SGD fine-tune's R >= 0.8 at every step and above every Adam fine-tune's R on the same task and seed at the same step; (b) Spearman >= 0.7. Both parts reported separately
predictions.predicted: pass: one plain SGD step's adjoint split is one component-training step, and E22's outside-both share for SGD is 0.03-0.06; Adam's per-coordinate rescaling is not a sum of gradients (E14 R 0.58 -> 0.42 -> 0.31)
predictions.expected: Adam 3e-5 emoticon R 0.58 / 0.42 / 0.31 (G2); SGD high; a random update's R is low (E14 did not read it; not run here)
predictions.blind_to: cause: a correlation across optimisers and tasks, not an intervention on R
predictions.noise_floor: R deterministic given delta-W; Spearman over about 30 states that are not independent (three steps per fine-tune)
